# Experimental & Learning Vector DBs

- [vectordb-from-scratch](https://github.com/Ricoledan/vectordb-from-scratch) - vectordb-from-scratch is a Rust-based learning project implementing a vector database from basics, focusing on HNSW indexing internals and database fundamentals. Demonstrates core concepts like vector storage, ANN search, and persistence. Educational for understanding VDB architecture; not production-ready, contrasts full DBs like Qdrant.
